description: Process-energy term of the cradle-to-gate LCA: fuel and electricity consumed by each Step Method unit operation per kg of finished catalyst, converted to GWP and CED with public emission factors. Thermal steps (calcination, drying) are computed from first-principles sensible and latent heat divided by an equipment thermal efficiency; mechanical steps use order-of-magnitude specific energies. Every number below is an engineering screening value with its source and range; none is taken from the CatCost workbook.
boundary_note: Covers energy delivered to the unit operations listed in `steps`. Not covered: reaction enthalpies of precursor decomposition, process emissions (NOx from nitrate calcination, flare CO2), solvent and water supply, wastewater treatment, equipment embodied impacts, and the electrocatalyst coating line (area-based, listed as unmodeled). Each occurrence of a step in a route is counted in full.

electricity_us_grid.source: EPA GHG Emission Factors Hub (January 2025), Table 6, US Average row: 771.5 lb CO2/MWh, 0.057 lb CH4/MWh, 0.008 lb N2O/MWh, eGRID2023; grid gross loss 4.2%. GWP100 AR5 (CH4 = 28, N2O = 265).
electricity_us_grid.derivation: 771.5 lb/MWh x 0.45359 = 349.95 kg CO2/MWh; + 0.02585 kg CH4 x 28 + 0.003629 kg N2O x 265 = 351.63 kg CO2e/MWh generated = 0.3516 kg/kWh; delivered = 0.3516 / (1 - 0.042) = 0.367 kg/kWh. CED uses an all-fuels primary-energy factor of ~9,500 Btu/kWh (10.0 MJ/kWh); EIA 2024 operating heat rates span 7,754 (natural gas) to 10,777 (coal) Btu/kWh, renewables 3,412 by convention.
electricity_us_grid.ced_source: EIA, Electric Power Annual, Table 8.1 average operating heat rates (2024).

natural_gas.source: EPA GHG Emission Factors Hub (January 2025), Table 1 Stationary Combustion, Natural Gas: 53.06 kg CO2/mmBtu, 1.0 g CH4/mmBtu, 0.10 g N2O/mmBtu (HHV). GWP100 AR5.
natural_gas.derivation: 53.06 + (1.0 x 28 + 0.10 x 265) / 1000 = 53.1145 kg CO2e/mmBtu; / 1055.056 MJ per mmBtu = 0.05034 kg CO2e/MJ. CED adds ~10% for upstream extraction, processing and transmission.

thermo.cp_solid_note: Mean heat capacity of an oxide support over 25-500 C. NIST-JANAF Al2O3 (corundum): 0.775 kJ/kg/K at 298 K rising to ~1.1 at 800 K.
thermo.latent_note: Enthalpy of vaporization of water at 100 C, standard steam tables.
thermo.efficiency_note: Fuel-to-product thermal efficiency of indirect calciners (0.3-0.5) and rotary/spray dryers (0.4-0.7); Perry's Chemical Engineers' Handbook, 9th ed., Sec. 12 (drying) and rotary-kiln practice. Screening values, replace with measured duty where available.

kiln_continuous_indirect.note: Sensible heat of 1 kg dry solid from ambient to calcination temperature / kiln efficiency. Decomposition enthalpy not included.

kiln_batch.note: As indirect kiln; batch heat-up losses not separately modeled.

dryer_rotary_40_100C.note: Water load = support pore volume filled by impregnation liquor (gamma-alumina 0.5-1.0 mL/g).

dryer_rotary_100_300C.note: As 40-100 C dryer with a higher outlet temperature.

dryer_batch_vacuum_tray.note: Steam-heated trays treated as natural-gas heat.

dryer_spray.note: Slurry feed ~35-40 wt% solids (1.5-1.9 kg water per kg solid).

crystallizer.note: Chiller/evaporator duty taken as electric equivalent; low confidence.

scrubber_nox.note: Fan and pump power only; abated NOx is a process emission, not modeled.

flare.note: No energy consumed; flared off-gas CO2 is a process emission, not modeled.

membrane_pretreatment.note: Area-based electrode line; per-kg factors not meaningful.

mechanical_source: Perry's Chemical Engineers' Handbook, 9th ed.: order-of-magnitude specific energies for agitated vessels (0.1-1 kW/m3), fine grinding of soft solids (5-30 kWh/t), paste extrusion (20-60 kWh/t), vacuum filtration (1-5 kWh/t). Screening values with ranges; evidence_tier engineering_assumption.
